name: Spiral Scroll Gallery
description: Dark scroll gallery where photos zigzag down the page and tumble in 3D as they scroll past, with a huge name marquee behind them, a focus color reveal and a frame counter.
contents: Vertical stack of images with optional captions and index labels
Large horizontal marquee of names behind the images
Frame counter, vignette, film grain and loading line overlays
behavior: Each image rotates in 3D and moves in depth, scrubbed by scroll
Images sway left and right along a sine path
Image in the viewport center turns from muted to full color
Marquee slides horizontally with scroll progress
Loading line shows until images are loaded
editableByProps: Images, captions, alt text and marquee names
All colors, blend mode and vignette strength
Image size, aspect ratio, radius, spacing, sway and rotation amounts
Toggle index labels, frame counter and focus color reveal

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the film grain strength or remove it

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Marquee, counter, vignette, grain and loader overlays are fixed to the viewport while the component is mounted
Uses window-level resize listener and GSAP ticker, both removed on unmount
Image sway is based on window width, so on narrow screens images shift near the edge and are clipped horizontally by the root
